title: Lane status — one role's live position in a swarm dispatch (PROJECTED)
comment:
A lane status is a PROJECTION, never a free-standing claim and never the receipt body itself. The receipt's `body` carries only the fields a worker routes/authored (schema_version, lane_id, role, state, agent, resolved_model); the ledger_required `ledger_ref` is STAMPED onto the projection AFTER append from the immutable receipt envelope (seq, hash, ts_wall). It cannot live in the body: append_receipt hashes the body before the envelope hash exists, so a body can never self-reference its own row. A consumer MUST assemble the projection from (body + envelope) the way keel/fleet/src/console.rs does in load_lane_status — it must never trust an authored ledger_ref. fleet's `fleet contract lane-status validate` does exactly this projection against the live ledger.

This is fleet-rs's half of the design-graph / lane-status object described in the orb repo's 11-THREE-MEMORY-LAYERS.md. The orb-side voice/graph UI that consumes this is a different repo and is NOT covered here.

lane_id.description: Stable identifier for this lane within one dispatch, currently the role name (one lane per role until C8 multi-lane concurrency lands).

role.description: AUTHORED BY THE ROUTER at routing time -- one of fleet-rs's five swarm roles (keel/fleet/src/roles.rs).

state.description: AUTHORED BY THE DISPATCH CALLER as it observes each lane transition. queued: routed but not yet executing. running: handed to run_with_evidence. passed: evidence verified and credited. failed: evidence faulted or the run errored. refused: a role gate (e.g. LEAD_WROTE_CODE, SELF_VERIFIED) refused the lane before it ran.

agent.description: AUTHORED. The adapter this lane was routed to (claude/codex/stub/...), null if not yet resolved.

resolved_model.description: AUTHORED. The model tier the router resolved for this lane, null if not applicable.

actor.description: STAMPED BY THE LEDGER (copied from the producing receipt's envelope actor, always the launcher, never a worker).

ts_wall.description: STAMPED BY THE LEDGER (copied from the producing receipt's ts_wall). Never supplied by a worker.

ledger_ref.description: STAMPED BY THE LEDGER at projection time. Links this status back to the exact append-only receipt row (seq, hash) that produced it -- a lane status is a projection of a ledger event, never a free-standing claim, and is never authored into the receipt body.
